limitations: Partial source coverage; no complete-city, country or Europe claim.
Counts are per mode and separate from bus and train counters; never summed with them.
Scheduled source records are not vehicles, ridership or proof of operation.
Lines the train layer already shows are held here or flagged alsoShownAsTrain; ownership is listed in docs/TRANSIT_PIPELINE.md.
Lines marked partlyHeld have route rows held for a mode-code conflict; each source's held lines, with the reason, are listed per source and shown to viewers.
Stops keep source identities; names and proximity never merge them.
A stop coordinate outside its source's declared countries is withheld from the map (listed per source as withheldStopCoordinates); the stop keeps its calls and timetable records.

Lines marked estimatedHeadway are drawn from the feed's headway windows (GTFS frequencies.txt, exact_times=0) on the dates those windows apply. Their windows are shown as estimates and never counted as recorded departures; timed trips of a mixed line are counted as usual.
